title: Aspirin and cardiovascular events
text: Low-dose aspirin reduced the risk of myocardial infarction in adults over 50 in a randomized trial of 20,000 participants.

title: Vitamin D supplementation and fractures
text: Daily vitamin D supplementation did not reduce hip fracture incidence among community-dwelling older adults.

title: IL-6 signalling in sepsis
text: Elevated interleukin-6 (IL-6) levels predicted mortality in patients admitted with septic shock.

title: Metformin and cancer incidence
text: Observational cohorts suggest metformin users with type 2 diabetes have lower colorectal cancer incidence.

title: Sleep deprivation and memory
text: Acute sleep deprivation impaired hippocampal memory consolidation in healthy volunteers.

title: Statins and LDL cholesterol
text: High-intensity statin therapy lowered LDL cholesterol by roughly fifty percent within twelve weeks.

title: BRCA1 mutations and breast cancer
text: Carriers of pathogenic BRCA1 mutations face a substantially elevated lifetime risk of breast and ovarian cancer.

title: Exercise and depression
text: Supervised aerobic exercise reduced depressive symptoms comparably to sertraline over sixteen weeks.

title: Gut microbiome and obesity
text: Fecal microbiota from obese donors increased adiposity when transplanted into germ-free mice.

title: Coffee consumption and Parkinson disease
text: Higher caffeine intake was associated with a lower risk of developing Parkinson disease in men.

title: CRISPR off-target effects
text: Whole-genome sequencing detected few off-target edits after CRISPR-Cas9 editing of human stem cells.

title: Antibiotics in early childhood
text: Antibiotic exposure in the first year of life was linked to higher rates of childhood asthma.
